crm_shell.lisbon_clock: Real-time clock displaying Lisbon time (Europe/Lisbon WET/WEST format: HH:mm:ss - D de MMMM, YYYY) at top right of CRM header.
crm_shell.footer: Discreet footer 'Criado por Victor Silva (Rafael Amorim)' centered/right at page bottom

dashboard_view.chart_7_days: Recharts line/area chart showing 7-day remote assistance volume.
dashboard_view.realtime_queue: Live list of pending assistance requests with client name, device type, wait time, priority tag, and 'Atender Agora' button.

assistance_viewer.stream_layout: Split layout with WebRTC Client Screen Stream on left/center and Diagnostic Side Panel on right.
assistance_viewer.stream_controls_rule: CRITICAL: Stream controls (zoom +, zoom -, fit, refresh, privacy toggle) MUST be placed OUTSIDE the video display frame, in a dedicated toolbar bar above or below the screen viewport to prevent obstructing the client's screen view.
assistance_viewer.privacy_mode_button: 'ATIVAR MODO DE PRIVACIDADE' / 'DESATIVAR MODO DE PRIVACIDADE' toggle button. Triggers dark blurred overlay on stream reading 'Ajuste Técnico em Curso - Modo de Privacidade Ativo'.

public_page.style: Ultra accessible, dark background, high contrast, clean big target components for non-tech users.
public_page.header: Logo 'APP DE SUPORTE TÉCNICO' prominently displayed
public_page.title: Bem-vindo ao APP DE SUPORTE TÉCNICO
public_page.subtitle: Vamos ajudar-te a resolver o teu problema
public_page.primary_action: Giant centered button 'CONECTAR' (lime green with high contrast black bold text, pulsing ring)
public_page.privacy_note: Clear reassuring message in pt-PT: 'Assistência 100% segura e consentida. Pode cancelar a ligação a qualquer momento.'

state_flow.idle: Show giant CONECTAR button & DESCARREGAR button
state_flow.waiting: Status card: 'A aguardar técnico…' with animated spinner and cancel button
state_flow.active: Status card: 'Assistência ativa', client chat window, and floating sticky bottom 'TERMINAR ASSISTÊNCIA' red button always visible
state_flow.privacy_overlay: Full viewport modal/overlay on client screen: 'Ajuste Técnico — Aguarde...'

technical_rules.styling: Tailwind CSS with custom modern dark theme classes
technical_rules.no_transparent_overlays: Ensure dropdowns, headers, and modals have solid or heavy backdrop-blur dark backgrounds (#111827 / #161e2e with backdrop-blur-md) never plain clear transparent.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript React (.js files) since the codebase uses JS.
Ensure all copy is strictly in Portuguese of Portugal (pt-PT).
Implement both the CRM app routes and the Public Support route (/conectar or /suporte).
Always include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and status badges.
Make sure stream controls and privacy toggle in the stream viewer are strictly located OUTSIDE the stream viewport area so video content is 100% visible.
Ensure Lisbon clock is live and updates every second showing Lisbon local time.
Include the required discreet footer 'Criado por Victor Silva (Rafael Amorim)'.
